title: wslua: Debugger: Hide functions, expose userdata attributes
description:
Filter functions and methods out of the Variables view (Locals,
Upvalues, Globals and table drill-down) so users only see data.
Tables report their visible (non-function) size so the expand arrow
and "table[N]" label match what is actually shown.

Make wslua userdata expandable by reading __getters off the instance
metatable and invoking each getter via lua_pcall with the userdata
as its sole argument. Getters that raise are surfaced as an "error"
row so a single failure does not break the rest of the expansion;
callable results are filtered like any other method.

Path traversal understands userdata too: "." and string-keyed "[]"
resolution goes through the same __getters lookup, so nested paths
such as Locals.pinfo.src walk from userdata into the returned value
and keep expanding transparently.

Ping #21193
